node.statement: For nonvanishing P and e<=e_ca, lem-compcb-corner-algebra says that S_P, with the compressed product dot and inherited involution, is an extended C_ca*e-C*-algebra. By the registered definition of extended epsilon-C*-algebra, for each n the amplified algebra M_n tensor S_P obeys the lower C*-axiom for its amplified compressed product: ||Z^dagger dot Z|| >= (1-C_ca*e)||Z||^2 for every Z in M_n tensor S_P. Taking K_sq>=C_ca gives exactly the square antecedent required by node 1.2 at every n, not merely at n=1.
